notes.title: Update Announcement [ver. 10587105]
notes.notes:
Update Announcement
Skyisland has been updated for the first and the last time. Many issues from reviews and discussions are suspected to be solved or completely solved. There will be no more updates unless some critical bugs or glitches are repeatedly reported often during a certain period of time. Again, Thank you to all those who played our game.

Updates
Improvements

 The dialog skipping feature has been improved by separating auto-skipping and manual-skipping in its circumstances.
 Puri will now talk to the player as soon as the game has started.
 Hit feedback of 'Homeros' has been improved.
 Vertical synchronization and graphics preset options have been added.
 You can now skip the cut-scene by holding the skip button.

Fixed Issues

 The master volume slider can no longer affect other sliders.
 Some problematic collision areas in Epirus have been improved.
 The audio settings now affect some audio clips and timelines that used to ignore their settings.

Miscellaneous

 A portion of the system requirements has been uprated.
 Credits of the sound team have been added to the game credit.
 Some of the nouns in Chinese localization have been changed.
 A portion of the rendering feature has been optimized.
 The Japanese localization has been revised.


 Rejected Suggestions 

 Improving the save/load feature.
 Implementing native controller support.
 Updating achievements.


 FAQ 
 Q. Why no more updates?  
 A. The main goal of the Skyisland project is to graduation of developers who are undergraduate students yet. Such a circumstance has left the minimum number of available developers in the live team, as such, we can only put a bare amount of effort into live services, such as solving serious issues which can affect the main gameplay, this includes critical bugs and glitches, performance issues, and minor improvements. Leaving this update as the last, the team will be completely dissolved.
 Q. I have some inquiries about the business 
A. Since our team will be dissolved after this update, It's sad to say that we cannot respond to any business inquiries. But you can contact the following Steam URL if you have an interest in a specific member of the team to suggest a job position or other opportunities.

Contact
https://steamcommunity.com/id/KennySquared/
